# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Email **security@cypherrum.com** — do **not** open a public issue.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours and ship a patch within 90 days under coordinated disclosure. We'll credit you in the release notes unless you ask us not to.

## Scope

In scope: the cypherrum desktop app (Windows / macOS / Linux), the `cypherrum-relay` binary, the cypherrum.com web property, and any official update / release-distribution channel.

Out of scope: third-party software, social-engineering attacks, denial-of-service through resource exhaustion alone.
